items.description: Exact-line paired audit: 1,243 decided rows, 99 games, 14 dates; champion 50.04%, distribution challenger 50.36%, always Lower 53.82%. Distribution Brier 0.271436 vs 0.272355; no qualified challenger.
Public chronological stats-only replay completed; no original-line hit rate.
135/135 reconstructed injury identity candidates, final four corroborated against primary ESPN rosters. Original immutable injury rows and untouched validation not verified; freeze not approved.

102,900 source-local player-map records, 10,290 maps. Repaired team context yields 17,520 retrospective test observations per market; opponent-adjusted MAE improves kills, deaths and assists. Separate Steam-native headshot cohort is not added to this total. No authoritative cross-provider player link or original-line approval.
73,950 player-map rows; map-conditioned test on 11,857 matched observations per market improved all three statistical errors.
200,040 historical player-game records; champion-conditioned test on 24,992 matched observations per market improved kills, deaths and assists error.
3,000 professional matches, 156 dates. Hero-conditioned historical error improved on 3,135 matched observations per market.

Separate 2026 bounded sample: 187 complete maps, 1,496 valid player-map rows across 15 dates. Mode-conditioned kills MAE 5.56 vs last-20 8.93; deaths MAE 5.07 vs 8.64, 304 matched observations per market. 2025 cohort (125 maps) and 2019 baseline remain separate.
